title: Water Water Everywhere...and Only a Drop of Coffee to Drink.
text:
Water Water Everywhere...and Only a Drop of Coffee to Drink.. One thing about this coffeemaker is that it will certainly help keep your countertops clean since it's nearly impossible to fill without spilling water everywhere. The design of the caraffe, while looking perfectly normal, is amazingly bad. Water pours down the caraffe & off the bottom every time. Maybe I'll someday master the technique of pouring water into the coffeemaker, but I don't often have the delicate skills of a brain-surgeon when I roll out of bed in the morning and stumble toward the kitchen.

Secondly, the maker does come with a permanent wire coffee basket, but I've never used it because it's so small. Perhaps it would work for most people, but I like my coffee a little on the strong side and the basket seems tiny. The good news is that you can still use paper filters in the coffeemaker, but the bad news is that you still have to use paper filters.

If space is a consideration, please be aware that the top of the coffeemaker is all one solid piece that lifts from the front. This means you need to have clearance above the maker that at least equals the depth of the appliance from front to back. My old 4-cup maker fit perfectly under a cabinet, but this one doesn't quite fit in the same space. Certainly it's no fault of the appliance, but I wish I'd realized it beforehand.

Lastly, a note to Southpaws. The lift-out coffee basket has a flat tab on the backside that serves, I guess, as a handle. The basket only fits one way, with the flat tab extending over the left side of the water resevoir. Lefties pouring water into the maker will have a difficult time missing the tab that sticks out over the water resevoir, and pouring water on the tab causes it to splash everywhere or pour down onto the hotplate area. It's probably not a good idea to lay your cell phone down anywhere around this coffeemaker.

Hello, Mr. Black & Decker? There are some people out here who prefer our morning cuppa with a little cream, little suger, no mop. Can you make that happen for us please?
